name: ActivityNet: Large-Scale Video Benchmark for Human Activity Understanding
description: ActivityNet (v1.3) is a benchmark dataset for human activity recognition and temporal action localization in untrimmed video. Comprising 19,994 YouTube video recordings totaling over 648 hours across 200 activity categories organized into a rich hierarchical taxonomy (e.g., sports, household chores, social interactions), each video contains on average 1.5 activity instances annotated with high-precision temporal start and end timestamps.
